title: Ensure 'Automatically send memory dumps for OS-generated error reports' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Error Reporting\Automatically send memory dumps for OS-generated error reports to 'Disabled'
reason: Memory dumps sent to Microsoft for error reporting could inadvertently contain sensitive information such as passwords, encryption keys, or user data.

title: Ensure 'Configure Default consent' is set to 'Enabled: Always ask before sending data'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Error Reporting\Consent\Configure Default consent to 'Enabled: Always ask before sending data'
reason: Ensures that the system does not automatically send potentially sensitive error data to external servers without explicit administrative approval.
